description: An arithmetic expression, a function or any operand other than a bare identifier in the SOURCE clause of a report group description entry (kb/Work PB3964). ANSI X3.23-1985's format is `SOURCE IS identifier-1`; ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 115 QUOTES the change: 'SOURCE allows arithmetic expressions and functions and a ROUNDED phrase'. The 2023 text is 13.18.53.2 (`{ identifier-1 | arithmetic-expression-1 }`) and 13.18.53.3 SR3 ('If arithmetic-expression-1 or the ROUNDED phrase is specified, the entry shall define either a numeric data item or a numeric-edited data item'). A parenthesized identifier is an arithmetic expression (SoleOperand.DataRef). Gated by recognition, VersionConformancePass ParseArm.VisitReportSourceClause, once per written clause; the SUM clause has its own forms and is not this row's.
display: an arithmetic expression or function as a SOURCE operand (report group description)
citation: ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 (substantive changes not affecting existing programs), item 115; ISO §2023:13.18.53.2, §2023:13.18.53.3 SR3 (2023 text)
vcr: VCR row 7.45 (85->2002: SOURCE takes an arithmetic expression or a function)

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. RSEX.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT PRT ASSIGN TO "RSEX.TXT".
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD PRT REPORT IS R1.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 WN PIC S9(3) VALUE -5.
REPORT SECTION.
RD R1 PAGE LIMIT IS 10 LINES.
01 DA TYPE DETAIL LINE PLUS 1.
    02 COLUMN 1 PIC S9(3) SOURCE WN + 1.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN OUTPUT PRT.
    INITIATE R1.
    GENERATE DA.
    TERMINATE R1.
    CLOSE PRT.
    STOP RUN.
